problem:
The position $x(t)$ of a particle (in meters) at time $t$ seconds is given by 

$$
x(t)=2{t}^{2}-10t+3,\,t\ge 0.
$$

Calculate the time at which the particle is stationary. Do not round your answer.

Therefore, the particle is stationary at $t=$
{{field-1}}
$\text{s}.$
